usedFor: Shopify holds abandoned checkouts and Keap Max Classic holds contacts, so “Abandoned Checkout” can run “Add or Update Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify, then “Add or Update Contact” in Keap Max Classic
bestTemplate.why: A shopper who left after entering an email or phone becomes a contact, so you can follow up.

watchOut: “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify is polling, so the contact reaches Keap Max Classic after a scheduled check.
